items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) did not practice for the second straight day. McVay says not long-term and no hernia but not making great progress; erring on caution with time to heal. Unlikely for Week 3 vs DEN.
items.implication: Adams continues elevated role; sit Nacua

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) did not practice for the second straight day. Trending toward missing Week 3.
items.implication: Schultz and other HOU pass-catchers elevated

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after knee surgery (MCL/meniscus; ACL intact). Out for regular season; full recovery expected, remote playoff chance.
items.implication: NYG QB situation unsettled long-term; Nabers/others impacted

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) missed practice for the second straight day. Looking like another miss; travel to Brazil complicates. First hurt Aug 20 joint practice, aggravated Week 1 after 5-150-1 half.
Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (core muscle surgery); played just 5 games across 3 seasons. Elevates Chuba Hubbard firmly to lead role (RB14 utilization), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.opportunity: Clear lead back snaps/carries/targets for Hubbard

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) at practice after good MRI results; expects to play Monday vs Bears. Limited participation with cowboy collar but positive trajectory.
items.implication: Lock in lineup; handcuffs less valuable

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert (MCL sprain) expected to miss multiple weeks; avoiding IR for faster potential return. DNP Thursday. Johnny Mundt/Ertz fill in short-term.
items.implication: TE streamer needed; limited upside for Mundt

items.text: TNF questions: Is Penix healthy enough to revive Drake London and Kyle Pitts? Does Reed absence lead to more 2-TE sets? Can Packers OL hold for Watson/Golden? Lloyd may have ceded to Kaleb Johnson.
items.why: Penix return + Reed OUT + backfield shift
items.implication: London/Pitts bounce-back candidates; Watson elevated; fade Lloyd

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua on the field as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in two missed games: 5-35-3 vs JAX (2025) and 8-195-2 vs NYG. Clear WR1 opportunity if Nacua sits again.
items.why: Route/target share data + production in prior absences
items.implication: Must-start WR1 with elite ceiling vs DEN
items.opportunity: 42% target rate, red-zone upside without Nacua

items.text: Loves Brock Purdy vs ARI: SF implied total 28 (3rd-highest), ARI secondary lost top CB to IR, bottom-8 YPA/TD rate allowed. Clean smash spot.
items.why: High total + weak ARI pass D

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): Highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.opportunity: High carry volume vs soft front

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts both weeks, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share last week sans Collins; IND 4th-most yds to TEs).

Hates Travis Etienne (only 49% RB touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara), Rhamondre Stevenson (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX tough vs RBs), Terry McLaurin (SEA fewest FPPG to WRs, low team total).
items.implication: Sit or fade in favor of better options
items.conflict: Henderson usage rising vs Stevenson ranking

items.text: Fact: Post-Stevenson fumble, Henderson 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. London averages 20+ PPR/35% tgt share/97 yds in 12 career games with Penix. Schultz 30% route target rate sans Collins.
items.implication: Henderson rising; London smash with Penix; Schultz startable
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead of Henderson short-term
